information_for_contributors: Hand-written, unlike bash.json which is a vendored TextMate grammar.

The upstream YAML grammar (https://github.com/textmate/yaml.tmbundle) relies on Oniguruma extended-mode regexes ((?x) free-spacing), which Dart's RegExp cannot parse, so syntax_highlight_lite throws 'FormatException: Invalid group' on it.
This covers flat scalars, which is what the shipped content uses. Replace it with the upstream grammar once syntax_highlight_lite gains an Oniguruma-compatible regex engine.
name: YAML
